description:
Turn text into embedding vectors with any embedding model in the Hubris catalogue — for semantic search, RAG, deduplication and clustering. Same as POST /v1/embeddings, OpenAI shape: data[i].embedding is the vector for input[i].

Pass a list of strings to embed a batch in one call, which is faster and cheaper than one call per string. Vectors are long: 1536 numbers make about 30 KB of JSON, and the whole answer lands in your context. Embed only what you will actually store or compare, use `dimensions` where the model allows it, and send large batches through the HTTP API (POST /v1/embeddings).

Spends money from the account balance: billed per input token. usage.cost_rub is what this call cost.

dimensions.description: Shorter vectors, only on models that support it (openai/text-embedding-3-*). Leave out otherwise.

input.description: Text to embed: one string, or a list of up to 16 strings embedded in one call.

model.description: Model id from the catalogue, vendor included and matched exactly, e.g. "openai/text-embedding-3-small". Find one with models_search and tool: "embeddings_create".

name: embeddings_create
title: Create embeddings
